science_claim_ceiling: PROPOSAL_ONLY; no new laboratory measurements; no proof of BC-placental-ECM interaction, stability, biocompatibility, tissue compatibility or materials improvement

literature_anchors.claim_limit: Human placental decellularized membranes have been structurally and mechanically characterized; not evidence of BC/dECM composite performance.
Placental ECM with alginate and silk-fibroin was studied experimentally; different materials from BC.
Schneider Lab explicitly works with placenta-derived decellularized ECM; acceptance of JANUS study not established.

research_question: Can independently sourced, preformed bacterial cellulose (BC) and already decellularized characterized placental ECM (dECM) form a mechanically testable, compositionally attributable acellular interface distinguishable from simple surface carryover, an inert coating, or generic collagen loading?

primary_hypotheses.text: Any BC+dECM apparent material change is explained by coating/added mass, handling, hydration, generic collagen or batch effects; no specific interface advantage is established.

The BC+dECM preformed assembly retains identifiable dECM signals at a reproducible interface after a standardized wash and shows different wet-state delamination response versus matched generic-protein and inert-scaffold controls.
A distinct internal interpenetrating architecture is only possible to claim with orthogonal depth-resolved imaging; surface adherence alone cannot satisfy this.

not_included: bacterial cellulose biosynthesis with placenta or human milk
raw placenta processing outside an authorized tissue bank
sample_inputs: Independent laboratory-produced/preformed, chemically and structurally verified bacterial cellulose sheet or matched film
Documented, already decellularized human placental ECM obtained only by authorized ethical material supplier or in-house approved tissue bank
Traceable, characterized nonplacental purified collagen reference material
Nonbioactive inert scaffold reference and vehicle/buffer controls
no_acquisition_until: independent laboratory written feasibility and custodianship consent
ethics/tissue sourcing determination by institutional responsible officer

arms.role: Identify intrinsic dECM mechanics/spectra, not interpreted as BC

arms.material: BC plus a nonplacental purified collagen reference, matched for accessible protein mass where independently measurable
BC plus traceable decellularized placental ECM, acellular contact/lamination only

contrast_frozen_before_material_readout: D_BC_PLACENTAL_DECM versus C_BC_GENERIC_COLLAGEN for wet interface mechanics with direct mass/thickness and hydration controls
D_BC_PLACENTAL_DECM versus A_BC_SHAM for dECM retention and mapped interface markers
D_BC_PLACENTAL_DECM versus E_BC_INERT_SCAFFOLD for nonspecific loading/coating response
design.randomization: Independent lab assigns blinded specimen IDs before property testing. Balance by dECM donor/lot and BC production lot; all exclusions logged before revealing arm key.
design.unit_of_inference: Independent BC production lot crossed with independently sourced dECM donor/processing lot; technical specimens are nested observations, not independent donors.
design.independent_lots_minimum_for_feasibility: Aim >=3 independent certified dECM donor/processing lots and >=3 BC fabrication lots. If unavailable: classify descriptive feasibility-only and do not claim replication.
design.non_operational: No culturing recipes, exposure temperatures, growth media, sterilization/decellularization steps or human tissue handling instructions in this artifact.

G0_BC_IDENTITY: Document BC material origin, absence of live culture and verified cellulose identity with orthogonal spectroscopy or chemistry
Record dry mass, wet thickness, hydration, and lot-level batch properties before assembly
G1_DECM_IDENTITY: Signed tissue provenance and donor consent/waiver determination from authorized institution
Decellularization quality documentation, residual DNA/cell-content assay and biosafety clearance
Quantified matrix collagen, fibronectin/laminin where assay permits; residual detergent and microbial burden certification as applicable
No use without ethics/material transfer clearance
G2_INDEPENDENCE: Independent third-party measurement keeper and prespecified release policy
Freeze calibration tolerances, test method, equipment, operator, endpoint and exclusion rules before outcome access
G3_INTERFACE: Identify cellulose and dECM by at least two orthogonal chemical/structural methods
Use cross-sectional depth-resolved analysis to separate interpenetration from surface coating
Evaluate retention after lab-standardized non-destructive wash without using outcomes to tune washing
G4_BIAS_CONTROL: No inferred human fetal sex or milk property
No pTM or AcsD/FN1 prediction used as ground-truth material endpoint
No unblinding or data-driven thresholds before full receipt freeze

endpoints.primary: Wet-state interfacial delamination energy or equivalent calibrated peel response per unit width/area measured on coded material assemblies; exact standardized instrument method and unit frozen by lab before any outcome.
endpoints.coprimary_mechanism: Fraction or intensity of source-attributed dECM markers remaining associated with BC after a blinded standardized wash, normalized to deposited reference and negative controls.
secondary: Cross-sectional mapping of layer location and penetration depth
Wet-state tensile or shear response corrected for thickness and added material
Water uptake, hydrated thickness and pore/fiber morphology
Material chemistry by cellulose-specific plus ECM-specific orthogonal characterization

analysis.pre_outcome_freeze: Instrument measurement dynamic range, blank subtraction, physical effect size of interest, minimum measurable delamination, measurement repeatability and equivalence tolerances are fixed using calibration controls unrelated to treatment outcomes.
analysis.primary_estimator: Between-arm difference in wet delamination response (D-C primary; D-E sensitivity) with confidence interval and donor/BC lot stratification.
analysis.uncertainty: Hierarchical donor/BC-lot-aware model if sufficient independent lots; otherwise descriptive lot-resolved CIs and no population inference. Technical repeats do not inflate biological n.
analysis.multiplicity: Two named primary outcomes require explicit joint/multiplicity control or hierarchical order locked before data reveal; secondary analyses exploratory.
falsifiers: No valid source and decellularization evidence => STUDY_HOLD
ECM signal does not persist beyond wash/blank => NO_RETENTION_SUPPORT
Any visual signal is only surface deposition => INTERPENETRATION_NOT_SUPPORTED
Material improvement reproduced by matched collagen/inert added-mass controls => NO_PLACENTA_SPECIFIC_EFFECT
One dECM lot explains result => NO_INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION
Sample sizes too small or missing calibration => DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY
No independent signed blinded receipt and frozen analysis => NO_INDEPENDENT_VALIDATION_CLAIM

minimum_terms: Written confirmation where primary unpublished outcomes are retained
No JANUS/model-team access to raw primary readouts before prediction/data-freeze, where blind validation is claimed
Signed timestamp of material IDs, protocol version, exclusion log, instruments and raw result digest
Pre-agreed release procedure and handling of negative results
